name: shader-reveal-transition

frames.best_why: Frame 2 catches the pink and green noise shader at full strength during a scene change.

tagline: Photos wipe into each other under a colourful noise or stripe shader.
summary: A framed image card that swaps scenes behind a full-cover WebGL shader. Each change plays one of eight effects — noise, wipe, circle, stripes, zoom, luma, planetary or push — chosen from pills beneath the frame.
appearance: A wide 16:9 photo sits in a rounded frame with a place name and white title in the lower left. Under it, a row of small round outline pills names eight effects, with Next scene at the right; mid-change the frame fills with pink, green and cyan shader patterns.
behaviour: Pressing Next scene starts a shader wipe: a bright noise, blade or stripe pattern sweeps across the frame, the photo swaps at the midpoint, and the pattern fades to reveal the new one. Choosing a pill sets the effect for the next wipe.
demo_content: Mountain, horse and plant photos labelled Dolomites, Lofoten and Patagonia with titles like 'Above the cloud line'.
use_when: A gallery or hero needs a memorable scene change between images, and a plain crossfade feels too ordinary.
avoid_when: It runs a WebGL loop per wipe and needs a sized frame, so low-end or reduced-motion users get a plain swap.
customise: Children are the current scene, transitionKey triggers a wipe, variant picks one of eight effects, and duration and onRest are props; colours live in the shader source.
weight_why: A WebGL shader and requestAnimationFrame loop run for every reveal.

a11y.note: Reduced motion swaps scenes instantly and the controls are real buttons, but the shader canvas has no accessible description.

issues: The variant pills are tiny outlined text with low contrast against the dark stage.
polish_why: The shader wipes are vivid and varied; the pill controls are small and plain by comparison.
title: Shader Reveal Transition
